newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson wins 760 mln SKR Brazil deal.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson wins 760 mln SKR Brazil deal.

text.p: Swedish telecoms giant LM Ericsson AB on Friday said it had won a deal to supply AXE digital telephone exchange systems worth 760 million Swedish crowns ($115 million) to Brazilian telecoms operators Embratel and Telecomunicacoes do Rio de Janeiro SA - Telerj.
Ericsson wins 760 million SKR Brazil deal =2

Ericsson said in a statement the contract with Embratel, the largest long-distance telecoms operator in Brazil, covered the supply and installation of AXE exchange equipment to extend the phone network in major Brazilian cities.
A separate deal with Embratel related to the introduction of Intelligent Network solutions for the international AXE station in Sao Paulo, and the upgrading of the exchange, Ericsson said.
The contract with Telerj, which is the regional operator in Rio De Janeiro, is to supply exchange and transmission equipment for AXE networks, Ericsson said.
These deals brought the value of orders announced by Ericsson during the week to around 7.2 billion crowns.
On Tuesday, the company said it had signed a 2.6 billion crown framework agreement with two Chinese partners to supply digital mobile phone systems.
This was followed up on Thursday with another Chinese order, this time a 1.8 billion crown package to increase mobile telephony capacity in Guangdong province.
Thursday also saw the announcement of a two billion crown contract to supply digital PCS equipment and other mobile telephone systems to U.S. telecoms giant AT&T.
